meta.title: perf: migrate listHandler to AttributeRepository + cache attributes fetching in RSCs
meta.body_summary: Devin migrated the attributes list database query from a tRPC handler into AttributeRepository; the maintainer then added RSC caching with revalidation to reduce repeated fetches and improve rendering performance.

perf_labels.notes: Devin migrated listHandler to AttributeRepository; maintainer added RSC caching with revalidation; merged after human commits enhanced performance aspect.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 789 changed lines (though many from a merge bringing unrelated files), this is a medium-sized edit by absolute volume. The PR merged after maintainer added caching and revalidation, aligning with a performance-oriented change.

review_details.concern_detail: Initial Devin migration lacked caching; maintainer hbjORbj dismissed the initial approval, added caching logic (React.cache) in RSC pages, and revalidation on changes.
review_details.performance_claim: Migrate listHandler to repository and cache attributes fetching to improve RSC data loading speed.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: repeated_unnecessary_database_calls (prior behavior; not in taxonomy enum)

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin performed a direct code migration but missed the opportunity to cache the attributes list; the maintainer identified and added RSC-specific caching after review, indicating agent gap in performance-optimizing RSC data patterns.

detection_detail.code_reading: hbjORbj reviewed the initial repository migration and identified that the attributes list could be cached to avoid repeated fetches in RSC pages.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling; only manual testing and type-checking.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Maintainer directly added caching commits, including revalidation logic, before final approval.

core_change_summary.description: Devin moved the database query from list.handler.ts to a new findAllByOrgIdWithOptions static method in AttributeRepository, removing direct prisma import. Subsequently, maintainer added caching of attributes list in RSC pages (organizations/members) with React cache and revalidation logic, and refactored page structure (consolidated [id]/members page).
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Many additional files were changed via a merge from main, including unrelated workflow reminders and calendar service updates, not part of this PR's performance goal.
change_trajectory: Initial Devin commit: migrate listHandler to AttributeRepository.
Maintainer added caching with React.cache in RSC pages.
Multiple fix commits: refactors, revalidations, remove redundant code.
Merge from main brought unrelated changes.

review_signals.summary: Initially approved without body, then dismissed while adding caching fixes.
review_signals.action_taken: Dismissed approval and made commits to add caching.

review_signals.summary: Noted that the new page export is same page with different layouts, simplifying code.
Tested locally and approved for merge with intention to test further in QA.
Devin bot announced automated comment/CI assistance.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by Devin with repository migration; maintainer hbjORbj assigned and reviewed.
Maintainer dismissed approval and made multiple commits to add caching, revalidation, and refactor pages.
After CI e2e results posted and manual testing, maintainer approved and merged.
